about: Country cards for lives born in Pakistan. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Pakistan (PK) ===================== Committees (ROSCAs): common among salaried and self-employed people; no legal contracts (HRMARS study; finclusion.org 2017). Risk is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Friends at work run a “committee” (also called a BC): everyone pays in every month, and each month one member, picked by draw, takes the whole pot. There is no written contract; it runs on trust.

zh..x: 公司的朋友办了一个“会”（也叫BC）：每人每月交钱，每月抽签由一人拿走全部会钱。没有书面合同，全靠信任。

zht..x: 公司的朋友辦了一個「會」（也叫BC）：每人每月交錢，每月抽籤由一人拿走全部會錢。沒有書面合同，全靠信任。

events.src: The Gulf: a record $38.3bn of remittances in FY2025, $9.3bn from Saudi Arabia and $7.9bn from the UAE (State Bank of Pakistan, via Profit). Fees, pay and housing multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: A recruiter offers a three-year contract in Saudi Arabia or the UAE at about {a} a year, with housing provided. Those two countries sent about $17 billion of the record $38.3 billion that Pakistanis abroad sent home in 2024–25.

zh..x: 一家中介给你一份去沙特或阿联酋的三年合约，年薪约{a}，包住宿。2024–25年度巴基斯坦侨汇创下383亿美元的纪录，其中约170亿来自这两个国家。

zht..x: 一家中介給你一份去沙烏地阿拉伯或阿聯的三年合約，年薪約{a}，包住宿。2024–25年度巴基斯坦僑匯創下383億美元的紀錄，其中約170億來自這兩個國家。

events.src: Floods: in 2022 a third of the country was under water and about 33 million people were affected; damage $14.9bn and losses $15.2bn (Post-Disaster Needs Assessment, Planning Commission). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: The 2022 monsoon floods put a third of Pakistan under water and affected about 33 million people; damage and losses came to about $30 billion. Your district lies in a flood plain.

zh..x: 2022年的季风水灾让巴基斯坦三分之一的土地泡在水里，约3,300万人受灾，损害和损失约300亿美元。你住的地区在洪泛平原上。

zht..x: 2022年的季風水災讓巴基斯坦三分之一的土地泡在水裡，約3,300萬人受災，損害和損失約300億美元。你住的地區在洪泛平原上。

events.src: Inflation: 38% in May 2023, a record (Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, via Business Recorder). The yearly loss is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Inflation hit 38% in May 2023, the highest on record. Savings accounts pay less than that, so money left in rupees loses value.

zh..x: 2023年5月通胀率达到38%，创历史新高。储蓄账户的利息比这低，存在卢比里的钱会缩水。

zht..x: 2023年5月通膨率達到38%，創歷史新高。儲蓄帳戶的利息比這低，存在盧比裡的錢會縮水。

events.src: Behbood Savings Certificates: for people 60+, widows and disabled people; 12.72% a year from 4 Nov 2025, monthly profit, 10 years (National Savings, via ARY News). With inflation near 5–7% and withholding tax, about 5% real: an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Behbood Savings Certificates, for people aged 60 or more and for widows, pay a monthly profit: 12.72% a year for money put in from November 2025, for ten years.
en..buy.s: Put {a} in. About 5% a year after inflation and tax, paid monthly.

zh..x: 福利储蓄凭证（Behbood）专为60岁以上的人和寡妇设计，按月付利：2025年11月起存入的钱年利率12.72%，为期十年。
zh..buy.s: 放入{a}。扣除通胀和税后每年约5%，按月付利。

zht..x: 福利儲蓄憑證（Behbood）專為60歲以上的人和寡婦設計，按月付利：2025年11月起存入的錢年利率12.72%，為期十年。
zht..buy.s: 放入{a}。扣除通膨和稅後每年約5%，按月付利。

events.src: Solar: grid power rose from about Rs 9 a unit in 2015 to Rs 44 in 2024; about 17 GW of panels imported in 2024; net-metering buy-back being cut from Rs 27 to Rs 10 a unit (Wikipedia "Solar power in Pakistan"; Payne Institute; PIDE). System costs and savings are ESTIMATES.

go.do: const t = T('pk_solar', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.pk_solar') }); pay(c); t.v -= c; rec('pk_solar', -v, 15)

en..x: Grid power cost about Rs 44 a unit in 2024, and Pakistan imported about 17 GW of solar panels that year. Net metering lets you sell spare power back, but the buy-back rate is being cut from Rs 27 to about Rs 10 a unit.
en..solar.s: About {a} now; your bills fall by about {b} a year.
en..small: A few panels and an inverter
en..small.s: About {a} now; your bills fall by about {b} a year.

zh..x: 2024年电网电价约每度44卢比，那一年巴基斯坦进口了约17吉瓦的太阳能板。净计量制度让你把多余的电卖回电网，但收购价正从每度27卢比降到约10卢比。
zh..small: 几块板子加一台逆变器

zht..x: 2024年電網電價約每度44盧比，那一年巴基斯坦進口了約17吉瓦的太陽能板。淨計量制度讓你把多餘的電賣回電網，但收購價正從每度27盧比降到約10盧比。
zht..small: 幾塊板子加一台逆變器

events.src: EOBI: employers pay 5% and workers 1% of the minimum wage; a pension of at least Rs 10,000 a month from July 2023, at 60 (55 for women) after 15 years (OECD Pensions at a Glance Asia/Pacific 2024; Dawn). Rs 120,000 a year ÷ a full year at the minimum wage (Rs 444,000) ≈ 0.27.

en..x: You can ask your employer to register you with EOBI, the old-age pension fund: the employer pays 5% and you 1% of the minimum wage. After 15 years of contributions you get at least Rs 10,000 a month from 60 (55 for women).
en..reg.s: About {a} a year from your pay; a pension of at least {b} a year later.

zh..x: 你可以请雇主帮你登记员工养老福利机构（EOBI）：雇主付最低工资的5%，你付1%。缴满15年后，60岁（女性55岁）起每月至少领10,000卢比。
zh..reg.s: 每年从薪水扣约{a}；以后每年至少领{b}的养老金。

zht..x: 你可以請僱主幫你登記員工養老福利機構（EOBI）：僱主付最低薪水的5%，你付1%。繳滿15年後，60歲（女性55歲）起每月至少領10,000盧比。
zht..reg.s: 每年從薪水扣約{a}；以後每年至少領{b}的退休金。

events.src: School: free and compulsory education for children 5–16 (Constitution, Article 25-A, 2010); low-fee private schools are common. Fees and outcomes are ESTIMATES.

go.do: if (a) { T('pk_school', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.schoolFees') }); rec('pk_school', a, 12); } kidWin(p, .75)

en..x: The Constitution guarantees free schooling for children aged 5 to 16, and many families also choose low-fee private schools.
en..top.h: A good chance of a university scholarship later.
en..low.h: Some chance of a scholarship later.
en..govt.h: A smaller chance of a scholarship later.

zh..x: 宪法保障5到16岁的孩子免费上学，很多家庭也会选择收费低的私立学校。
zh..top.h: 以后拿大学奖学金的机会大。
zh..low.h: 以后有一些机会拿奖学金。
zh..govt.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会较小。

zht..x: 憲法保障5到16歲的孩子免費上學，很多家庭也會選擇收費低的私立學校。
zht..top.h: 以後拿大學獎學金的機會大。
zht..low.h: 以後有一些機會拿獎學金。
zht..govt.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會較小。
